Here are the deadlines and dates in October 2026, soonest first.

**Deadlines**
- Return overdue library media, due Fri 2 Oct 2026. Post or send it by Mon 28 Sep 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. After that, late fees rise per item per opening day.
- Cancel the Ausländerbehörde appointment if you can't attend, by Fri 9 Oct 2026. The send-by date is Mon 5 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78].
- Optional objection against the Muster BKK contribution notice, due Wed 14 Oct 2026. The send-by date is Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- Objection against the tax assessment (Finanzamt), due Wed 21 Oct 2026. The send-by date is Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a].
- Cancel the FunkNetz Smart M mobile contract. It must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026, so send it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- Special cancellation of the MusterStrom Flex electricity contract because of the price rise. It must arrive by Sat 31 Oct 2026. The send-by date is Mon 26 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5].

**Appointments**
- Dental check-up on Thu 8 Oct 2026 at 09:15 [item:itm_0jf0fq5r5ydx].
- Residence permit extension appointment on Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. The fee is payable on site by girocard on the same day [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].

**Payments**
- Parking warning fee, due Fri 2 Oct 2026. The amount was read by AI from a scan, so please check it against the paper letter: "30.00 €". Send it by Thu 1 Oct 2026 [item:itm_w1ny8kz9kmwt].
- Rent, due Mon 5 Oct 2026: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
- Additional service charges for 2025, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 €. Send it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Recurring direct debits:
  - Gym fee, Thu 1 Oct 2026: 29.90 € [item:itm_chhc59r0d16v].
  - Deutschlandticket, Thu 1 Oct 2026: 63.00 € [item:itm_2s90qr4prp13].
  - Electricity advance, Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 € [item:itm_kttk9625293w].
  - Health insurance contribution, Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].
- Incoming: your scholarship stipend is due Thu 1 Oct 2026: 450.00 € [item:itm_j2650a27bsty].

The library return's send-by date is today or already past, so that one is the most urgent. The residence permit appointment is also important. The record says the permit ends on 30 November 2026 if the extension isn't applied for before it expires.
